name: React Frontend CI/CD

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "frontend/**"
      - ".github/workflows/react-frontend-ci.yml"
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "frontend/**"
      - ".github/workflows/react-frontend-ci.yml"

concurrency:
  group: react-ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  NODE_VERSION: "20"
  WORKING_DIR: frontend

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint & Type Check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: ${{ env.WORKING_DIR }}/package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: ${{ env.WORKING_DIR }}
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run ESLint
        working-directory: ${{ env.WORKING_DIR }}
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Run type check
        working-directory: ${{ env.WORKING_DIR }}
        run: npm run typecheck

  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: ${{ env.WORKING_DIR }}/package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: ${{ env.WORKING_DIR }}
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run tests
        working-directory: ${{ env.WORKING_DIR }}
        run: npm run test -- --coverage --ci

      - name: Upload coverage
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-report
          path: ${{ env.WORKING_DIR }}/coverage
          retention-days: 7

  build:
    name: Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [lint, test]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: ${{ env.WORKING_DIR }}/package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: ${{ env.WORKING_DIR }}
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build
        working-directory: ${{ env.WORKING_DIR }}
        run: npm run build
        env:
          NODE_ENV: production

      - name: Upload build artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: frontend-dist
          path: ${{ env.WORKING_DIR }}/dist
          retention-days: 7

  lighthouse:
    name: Lighthouse Audit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download build artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: frontend-dist
          path: ${{ env.WORKING_DIR }}/dist

      - name: Run Lighthouse
        uses: treosh/lighthouse-ci-action@v12
        with:
          configPath: .lighthouserc.json
          uploadArtifacts: true
          temporaryPublicStorage: true

  build-docker:
    name: Build Docker Image
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Log in to GHCR
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Extract metadata
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}-frontend
          tags: |
            type=sha,prefix=
            type=raw,value=latest

      - name: Build and push
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: ${{ env.WORKING_DIR }}
          file: ${{ env.WORKING_DIR }}/Dockerfile
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max

  deploy-staging:
    name: Deploy to Staging
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build-docker
    environment: staging
    concurrency:
      group: deploy-react-staging
      cancel-in-progress: false

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Deploy to staging
        uses: appleboy/ssh-action@v1
        with:
          host: ${{ secrets.STAGING_HOST }}
          username: ${{ secrets.STAGING_USER }}
          key: ${{ secrets.STAGING_SSH_KEY }}
          script: |
            cd ${{ secrets.STAGING_DEPLOY_PATH }}
            docker compose pull frontend
            docker compose up -d --no-deps frontend
            echo "Deployed React frontend ${{ github.sha }} to staging"

      - name: Health check
        run: |
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf "${{ secrets.STAGING_URL }}" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Staging frontend is healthy"
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "Waiting for staging... ($i/30)"
            sleep 10
          done
          echo "Health check failed"
          exit 1

  deploy-production:
    name: Deploy to Production
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: deploy-staging
    environment: production
    concurrency:
      group: deploy-react-production
      cancel-in-progress: false

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Deploy to production
        uses: appleboy/ssh-action@v1
        with:
          host: ${{ secrets.PRODUCTION_HOST }}
          username: ${{ secrets.PRODUCTION_USER }}
          key: ${{ secrets.PRODUCTION_SSH_KEY }}
          script: |
            cd ${{ secrets.PRODUCTION_DEPLOY_PATH }}
            docker compose pull frontend
            docker compose up -d --no-deps frontend
            echo "Deployed React frontend ${{ github.sha }} to production"

      - name: Health check
        run: |
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -sf "${{ secrets.PRODUCTION_URL }}" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "Production frontend is healthy"
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "Waiting for production... ($i/30)"
            sleep 10
          done
          echo "Health check failed"
          exit 1
